# BindIrq

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Delivers a device's interrupt as an event bit.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0A` SVC_BIND | `EVENT_IRQ (2)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err BindIrq(Handle ev_handle, Handle dev_handle, uint32_t bit);
```

**Registers:** `(EVENT_IRQ, event, device, bit) -> r0 status`

The kernel masks the interrupt line each time it fires; call IrqRearm() once the device's interrupt source has been cleared.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ev_handle` | in | Event handle with PERM_CNTL. |
| `dev_handle` | in | Device handle with PERM_MAP whose interrupt to take. |
| `bit` | in | Bit number, 0-30. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | A handle is not live. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `ev_handle` is not an event, or `dev_handle` is not a device. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `ev_handle` lacks PERM_CNTL, or `dev_handle` lacks PERM_MAP. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | The device has no interrupt, or `bit` is out of range. |
| [`ERR_BUSY`](../errors.md#err_busy) | Another space has already bound the interrupt. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The event has been destroyed. |
